outcome: Doppler flow patterns (Pulsatility Index, Systolic/Diastolic ratio, Resistance Index in uterine, umbilical, and middle cerebral arteries)
Emergency lower segment cesarean section (LSCS) rates
cohort: The study included 77 primigravida women aged 18 to 35 years.
finding: The uterine artery PI showed the highest sensitivity for detecting both PIH and IUGR at 18-22 weeks, while the uterine artery S/D ratio and umbilical artery PI were most accurate after 30 weeks, underscoring the crucial role of Doppler velocimetry in managing high-risk pregnancies.
mod_finding: Emergency lower segment cesarean sections were most common in cases with both PIH and IUGR.
gest_age: Assessments were performed between 18 and 22 weeks of gestation, with follow-up studies after 30 weeks.
